purpose: Compatibility role vocabulary and projection contract. Records carry identity, typed references and versioned attributes; rules specify operations, actions retain application histories, and views are derived observations. These role labels are not six irreducible entity types; source, authorization and execution owners remain separate.

plugin_tiers.foundation_projection: Ships the optional Dashboard's Now/Library projection and item-local execution drawer; it owns no conversation task or canonical authority.
plugin_tiers.bundled_capability: Reviewed capability shipped with a repository distribution; disabling it leaves the minimum conversation loop intact.
plugin_tiers.optional_extension: Installed only on explicit user intent; local, reversible, and never a prerequisite for first use.

invariants: One state axis has one meaning.
Frontend records intent; source writes require Codex or explicit user action.
Candidate relations must not be mixed with confirmed memory.
Durable action records belong in active context files, not only localStorage.
Dynamic graph is an explanation surface, not a full editable network.
